name: impactOf

versions.rationale: Typed stub from the seed plan (Core model); throws NotImplementedError until its phase lands.

Implemented as a breadth-first walk over dependents, and added an optional ImpactOptions parameter: the plan's interface-caller warnings need to know which changes broke an interface, which the list of changed uids alone cannot say.

docs: Units whose behaviour may have changed, ranked by distance from the edit. Changed units are `own`; their transitive dependents are `closure`, except direct callers of an interface change, which are `interface-caller`.
